Across town or across the state

Priced by your route

Questions

What's the difference between standard and Rush?

Standard is delivered the same day. With Rush, your order goes to the front of the line and is driven straight there, about 2 hours for trips within 50 miles.

How late can I book?

We run 8 AM to 10 PM every day. For long trips, booking earlier in the day gives the driver time to get there.
